name: NM-01
label: Safe D

key_factors: District leans Democratic by 7 points on the partisan baseline
Incumbent Stansbury holds a massive fundraising edge ($1.35M vs $100K)
Prediction markets price Stansbury near 96% to win
No public polling, so uncertainty rests on fundamentals alone
model.rationale: Stansbury combines a Democratic-leaning Albuquerque seat, incumbency, and a dominant financial advantage, while markets price her near-certain to win. With no polling to contradict the fundamentals, the race stays firmly in Safe D territory.
model.watch: Any late public polling showing a single-digit race or a major outside-spending surge for the Republican would warrant moving this toward Likely D.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Melanie Stansbury seeks a second full term in a Democratic-leaning Albuquerque-based district that voted about seven points Democratic in recent partisan baselines. She has raised roughly $1.35 million and holds over $400,000 on hand, dwarfing Republican Didi Okpareke's roughly $100,000 in receipts, and no outside groups are spending against her. Prediction markets give her about a 96% chance of winning.

No public general-election polls are available, so the forecast rests on district fundamentals, incumbency, and the money gap. Those point to a comfortable double-digit Democratic win, with modest uncertainty given the absence of direct polling.
